blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reliable uncertainty estimation is essential for deploying object detectors in autonomous systems operating in uncertain environments. Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) provides a principled framework for uncertainty-aware classification by representing network outputs as evidence and interpreting predictions through subjective logic. However, existing evidential object detectors typically combine evidential classification with regression uncertainty models that do not share the same theoretical foundation. In this work, we propose an evidential version of YOLOv8 in which both classification and bounding-box regression are formulated within a common evidential framework. Our approach exploits YOLOv8’s distribution-based bounding-box representation, allowing the evidential formulation to be applied not only to classification but also to localisation. As a result, both tasks produce belief, uncertainty, and probability estimates that can be interpreted within the Dempster–Shafer framework. Experiments on KITTI, MUSES, and nuScenes show that the resulting detector remains broadly competitive with standard YOLOv8 in terms of detection accuracy while providing a localisation uncertainty that effectively discriminates between correct and erroneous detections. Moreover, this uncertainty becomes increasingly discriminative under domain shift.
blocks.zh: 可靠的不确定性估计对于在不确定环境中运行的自主系统中部署物体探测器至关重要。 证深学习(EDL)通过将网络输出作为证据,并通过主观逻辑解释预测,为不确定性意识分类提供了一个原则框架. 然而,现有的证据对象探测器通常将证据分类与回归不确定性模型结合起来,这些模型并不具有相同的理论基础. 在这项工作中,我们提出了YOLOv8的证据版本,其中在共同的证据框架内制定分类和定界框回归。 我们的方法利用了YOLOv8基于分配的边框表示,使得证据表述不仅适用于分类,也适用于本地化。 因此,这两项任务都产生了信念,不确定性,概率估计,可以在Dempster–Shafer框架内被解释. 关于KITTI,MUSES,和nuScenes的实验显示,由此产生的探测器在探测精度方面与标准的YOLOv8保持了广泛的竞争,同时提供了定位不确定性,有效地区分了正确和错误的探测. 此外,这种不确定性在域转移下越来越具有歧视性。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Modern object detectors such as YOLOv8 achieve remarkable accuracy and real-time performance, making them attractive for robotics and autonomous driving [ 6 ] . However, their predictions are often overconfident, especially when operating in conditions that differ from the training data. In safety-critical applications, it is important not only to detect objects accurately but also to quantify the uncertainty associated with each prediction.
blocks.zh: YOLOv8等现代物体探测器取得了显著的精度和实时性能,使其对机器人和自主驾驶具有吸引力[6]. 然而,他们的预测往往过于自信,特别是在与培训数据不同的条件下运作. 在安全的关键应用中,不仅必须精确地探测出物体,而且必须量化与每项预测有关的不确定性。

blocks.en: Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) has recently emerged as an efficient, single-pass approach for uncertainty estimation. Rather than directly predicting probabilities, EDL predicts evidence and derives belief and uncertainty measures through subjective logic [ 12 , 7 ] . While several works have extended EDL to object detection, most focus on classification uncertainty [ 11 ] , and those that address localisation typically rely on Deep Evidential Regression (DER) proposed by Amini et al. [ 1 ] . Although both approaches are often referred to as evidential, they rely on fundamentally different mathematical formulations. Sensoy’s method [ 12 ] produces Dirichlet opinions that can be directly interpreted through subjective logic and Dempster–Shafer theory, whereas DER models regression targets using Normal-Inverse-Gamma distributions that do not define belief masses. Classification and localisation uncertainties therefore live in different frameworks, preventing a unified interpretation of detector outputs.
blocks.zh: 最近出现了一种有效、单行的不确定性估算方法。 EDL不是直接预测概率,而是通过主观逻辑来预测证据并得出信念和不确定性的度量. [12, 7]. 虽然有几部作品将EDL扩展至对象检测,但大多数作品都以分类不确定性为主 [11],而那些针对本地化的作品通常依赖于由Amini等人提出的"深度回归"(DER). [一]. 虽然这两种方法经常被称作证据法,但它们依赖于根本不同的数学公式. 森索伊的方法 [12] 生产 可以通过主观逻辑和 Dempster – Shafer 理论直接解释的Drichlet 意见,而 DER 模型回归目标则使用正常-反向-Gamma 分布,并不定义信仰质量. 因此,分类和本地化的不确定性存在于不同的框架之中,妨碍了对探测器输出的统一解释。

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose Ev-YOLO, a unified evidential formulation for object detectors based on Distribution Focal Loss (DFL), and demonstrate its implementation on YOLOv8. Our key observation is that DFL represents bounding-box coordinates as discrete distributions over bins rather than as direct regression targets [ 9 ] . This representation naturally matches the Dirichlet-based formulation introduced by Sensoy et al. [ 12 ] , enabling evidential learning to be applied directly to localisation. Consequently, any object detector relying on DFL can benefit from the proposed formulation. We reformulate both regression and classification within the same subjective logic framework, yielding belief, uncertainty, and probability estimates for localisation and classification. For classification, we preserve the multi-label design employed by YOLOv8 and many modern detectors by modeling each class independently using evidential binary classifiers.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出Ev-YOLO,一种基于分布焦丢失(DFL)的物体探测器的统一证据配体,并演示其在YOLOv8上的实施. 我们的关键观察是,DFL代表了边框-框坐标作为离散分布在bins上,而不是作为直接回归目标[9]. 这种表述自然与Sensoy等人提出的以Dirichlet为基础的配方相匹配。 [12],使证据学习能够被直接应用于本地化. 因此,任何依靠DFL的物体探测器都可以从提议的制剂中获益。 我们在同一主观逻辑框架内重新制定回归和分类,产生信念、不确定性以及本地化和分类的概率估计。 为了分类,我们保留了YOLOv8和许多现代探测器所使用的多标签设计,方法是独立地使用证据二进制分级器对每个类进行模型化.

blocks.en: Experiments on KITTI [ 5 ] , MUSES [ 3 ] , and nuScenes [ 4 ] show that the proposed detector remains competitive in detection accuracy while being better calibrated and providing a localisation uncertainty that reliably identifies erroneous detections and becomes more discriminative under domain shift.
blocks.zh: 关于KITTI [5],MUSES [3],和nuScenes [4] 的实验表明,拟议的探测器在探测准确性方面仍然具有竞争力,同时可以更好地校正,并提供定位不确定性,可靠地识别出错误的探测结果,并在域转移下变得更加具有歧视性.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are:
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献是:

blocks.en: • A unified evidential formulation of YOLOv8 for both classification and bounding box regression. • An evidential reinterpretation of Distribution Focal Loss enabling belief and uncertainty estimation for localisation. • A localisation uncertainty that reliably discriminates correct from erroneous detections and becomes more discriminative under domain shift, while detection accuracy remains competitive.

blocks.en: 2 Evidential Object Detection using Dempster–Shafer Theory and Subjective Logic
blocks.zh: 2 使用 Dempster – Shafer 理论和主观逻辑进行实验对象检测

blocks.en: To explicitly model predictive uncertainty in object detection, we replace the probabilistic outputs of the standard YOLOv8 detection head by evidential representations derived from the Dempster–Shafer Theory (DST) of evidence. In particular, evidential reasoning is applied both to bounding box localisation and object classification.
blocks.zh: 为了明确模拟物体探测中的预测不确定性,我们将标准YOLOv8探测头的概率输出取而代之的是来自证据的Dempster-Shafer理论(DST)的证据表示. 特别是,证据推理既适用于边框定位,也适用于对象分类.

blocks.en: The original YOLOv8 detector is optimized using three loss components: a localisation loss based on Complete IoU (CIoU), a DFL for bounding box regression, and a Binary Cross-Entropy (BCE) loss for classification. In our evidential formulation, the localisation loss remains unchanged, while the DFL and classification losses are replaced by evidential objectives derived from the framework of Sensoy et al. blocks.en: 2.2 Evidential Classification

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: The baseline YOLOv8n and our evidential variant are trained under identical conditions on a single NVIDIA H200 GPU. Both models are trained for 200 epochs using AdamW with an initial learning rate of 1.667 × 10 − 3 1.667\times 10^{-3} and β 1 = 0.9 \beta_{1}=0.9 , batch size 16 and input resolution 640 × 640 640\times 640 . The evidential regression head uses K = 16 K=16 discretisation bins. All hyperparameters, optimisation settings, and the random seed are shared; models differ only in the detection head and loss.
blocks.zh: 基线YOLOv8n和我们的证据变体在相同的条件下在单一的NVIDIA H200 GPU上训练. 两种型号都为使用AdamW的200个世纪所训练,初始学习率为1.667×10 − 3 1.667\tims 10^{-3}和β 1= 0.9\βa_{1}=0.9,批量尺寸为16并输入分辨率为640× 640\times 640. 证据回归头使用 K = 16 K = 16 光碟化桶. 所有超参数,优化设置,随机种子都是共享的;模型仅在检测头和丢失上有所不同.

blocks.en: Both models are evaluated without fine-tuning on the in-domain KITTI evaluation split (1,000 images; the remaining 6,481 are used for training) and, to probe robustness under distribution shift, on the MUSES and nuScenes datasets, with MUSES being a particularly severe shift due to its adverse meteorological conditions. To avoid label inconsistencies across datasets, all evaluations are restricted to the car and pedestrian classes.
blocks.zh: 两种模型在评估时都没有对域内KITTI评价分解进行微调(1,000个图像;其余的6,481个用于培训),为了探测分布转变下的稳健性,在MUSES和nuScens数据集上进行微调,由于气象条件不利,MUSES是一个特别严重的转变. 为了避免各数据集的标签不一致,所有评价都仅限于汽车和行人课.

blocks.zh: 表2:关于KITTI、MUSES和nuScens的评估结果,该模型以AUROC关于本地化的衡量标准接受了关于KITTI的培训。

blocks.en: Table 2 reports mAP 50 . The proposed model remains competitive with the baseline both in-domain and under shift, despite a moderate reduction in in-domain mAP. As detection accuracy is not the primary objective of the evidential formulation, these results primarily confirm that incorporating localisation uncertainty does not degrade nominal performance.
blocks.zh: 表2报告mAP 50。 拟议的模式与内域基线和正在转变的基线仍然具有竞争力,尽管内域方案略有减少。 由于检测精度不是证据制剂的首要目标,这些结果主要证实纳入本地化不确定性不会降低名义性能.

blocks.en: The main contribution lies in applying evidential learning to Distribution Focal Loss, thereby equipping each predicted box edge with calibrated localisation uncertainty. This is assessed in Table 2 via AUROC between the predicted uncertainty and the correctness label (IoU threshold 0.5 0.5 ), which quantifies the probability that an incorrect detection receives higher uncertainty than a correct one. For fair comparison, both models are first evaluated using predictive entropy H H over the per-coordinate bin distributions. Under this metric, the evidential model consistently achieves superior error discrimination across all datasets, with discrimination improving rather than degrading under distribution shift, consistent with an uncertainty that grows under unfamiliar conditions. Replacing entropy with evidential uncertainty K / S K/S yields comparable results, indicating that the improvement arises from the evidential formulation itself rather than a specific uncertainty estimator.
blocks.zh: 主要贡献在于将证据学习应用于分配焦距损失,从而使每个预测的框边都配备了校准的本地化不确定性. 表2通过AUROC在预测的不确定性和正确性标签(IoU阈值0.5 0.5)之间评估了这一点,该阈值量化了不正确检测得到比正确检测更高的不确定性的概率. 为了进行公平的比较,这两个模型首先使用预测式 en H 来评价每座坐标的宾分布. 根据这一衡量标准,证据模型在所有数据集中一贯实现优越的错误歧视,在分配转变下,歧视得到改善而不是有辱人格,这与在不熟悉的条件下增长的不确定性是一致的。 用K /S K/S 证据不确定性取代Entropy产生类似的结果,表明改进来自证据表述本身,而不是具体的不确定性估计器。

blocks.en: Robustness to input perturbations is further evaluated by corrupting KITTI images with additive Gaussian noise and measuring mean localisation uncertainty at ground-truth object locations. As shown in Figure 1 , uncertainty increases monotonically as mAP 50 decreases, confirming sensitivity to genuine input degradation rather than dataset-specific artefacts.
blocks.zh: 通过用添加剂高斯噪音腐蚀KITTI图像并测量地面-真实物体位置的平均定位不确定性,进一步评估输入扰动的强度。 如图1所示,随着mAP 50的减少,不确定性会单调地增加,这证实了对真正输入退化的敏感性,而不是数据集特有的手工艺品。

blocks.en: For completeness we also examine the calibration of the classification confidence (Table 1 ) through Expected Calibration Error (ECE [ 8 ] ). The proposed model exhibits a lower ECE in-domain, and the gap widens markedly under shift, where the baseline grows substantially over-confident. This result should be interpreted with caution: the baseline is not recalibrated; however, post-hoc calibration on in-distribution data is known to transfer poorly under shift [ 10 ] , so this is unlikely to be a decisive disadvantage. The evidential formulation also induces a mild under-confidence bias that mechanically lowers ECE, so part of the improvement reflects this effect; we therefore present it as supporting rather than primary evidence.
blocks.zh: 为了完整起见,我们还通过预期校正误差(欧洲经委会[8])审查分类置信度的校正情况(表1)。 拟议模式显示欧洲经委会内域面积较低,差距明显扩大,基线大大增强。 这一结果应谨慎地加以解释:基准没有重新校正;但是,分配后数据的校正已知在班次[10]下转移不当,因此这不可能是一个决定性的不利因素。 证据表述还引起一种轻度的不信任偏差,这种偏差机械地降低了欧洲经委会的地位,因此部分改进反映了这种效果;因此,我们把它作为佐证而不是主要证据。

blocks.en: Overall, these results show that an evidential DFL head furnishes a localisation uncertainty that is both a strong error detector and demonstrably responsive to distribution shift and input corruption, while leaving detection accuracy essentially unchanged and improving classification calibration.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,这些结果表明,一个证据DFL头提供了一种本地化的不确定性,既是一种强大的误差探测器,又对分布转移和输入腐败作出明显反应,同时检测准确性基本上保持不变并改进了分类校正.

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: We presented a unified evidential formulation of object detection in which localisation and classification are expressed within the same subjective-logic and Dempster–Shafer framework. The key observation is that Distribution Focal Loss already encodes each box coordinate as a discrete distribution over bins, naturally mapping to a Dirichlet evidence model; this extends evidential treatment from classification to localisation without architectural changes, enabling any DFL-based detector to adopt it. On YOLOv8, the resulting detector maintains competitive accuracy while improving calibration and providing informative localisation uncertainty: it better separates correct from erroneous detections than an entropy baseline, becomes more discriminative under domain shift, and increases monotonically as input quality degrades.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个统一的物体探测证据公式,其中在同一个主观逻辑和Dempster-Shafer框架内表达局部化和分类。 关键观察是,分配焦丢失已经将每个盒子的坐标编码为在垃圾桶上进行离散分布,自然地映射到Drichlet证据模型;这将证据处理从分类扩展到不改变建筑结构的地方化,使任何基于DFL的探测器都能采用. 在YOLOv8上,产生的探测器保持了竞争的精度,同时改进了校正并提供了信息化的本地化不确定性:它最好将正确与错误的探测区分开来,而不是一个 en基线,在域位移下变得更加有区别,随着输入质量的退化而单调增加.

blocks.en: A central contribution is the shared evidential representation for localisation and classification, where both outputs are expressed as belief masses. This opens the door to future work on Dempster–Shafer fusion across time, overlapping detections, or sensing modalities, with explicit uncertainty propagation, as well as potential applications to active learning and open-world detection.
blocks.zh: 中心贡献是地方化和分类的共同证据代表,其中两种产出都以信仰为主。 这为未来关于Dempster — — Shafer 组合的跨时间工作、重叠检测、或感知方式,以及具有明确不确定性的传播以及积极学习和开放世界检测的潜在应用打开了大门。

blocks.en: Limitations include preserved rather than improved accuracy under domain shift, where gains may partly stem from evidential loss regularisation rather than the representation itself. Classification uncertainty is also less robust than localisation, degrading under synthetic corruption as expected in single-pass evidential models. Future work should further disentangle aleatoric and epistemic localisation uncertainty and validate the approach on additional DFL-based detectors.
blocks.zh: 限制包括在域转移下保留而不是提高准确性,其中收益部分可能来自证据损失正规化,而不是代表性本身。 分类不确定性也不如本地化强,在合成腐败下会像单一通道证据模型所预期的那样受到贬低。 今后的工作应进一步分解感应和感应局部的不确定性,并验证基于DFL的额外探测器的方法。
